interpretations.hops: at most 5 redirects are followed, so a chain is at most 6 requests; every one counts
interpretations.latency: request issued to last body byte, 2xx only; failures count as never completing
interpretations.host_stopped_works: a work whose remaining URLs went unsent because the host-stop rule fired counts as a failure, as the ASM-2 denominator is written; asm2.failed_with_a_stopped_host shows how many, so the other reading can be computed without rerunning
interpretations.s2_chain_urls: every hop of a chain that started from an S2-only URL is recorded as host plus hash, not only the URL itself
interpretations.host_stop_on_resume: a resumed run replays the stop rule and Retry-After from the same session's log; a request logged as sent with no end is taken to have ended when the resume starts
